name: 40059 · Prospect, KY
findings: ZIP 40059 (Prospect) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40059 (Prospect) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
